title: Let’s Worm
summary: A prompt-driven literary art platform where short fiction and illustration take turns leading the way.
intro: Let’s Worm is an ongoing collaboration with writer Dan Murphy, pairing strange, compact stories with drawings, paintings, and visual experiments made in response.
